description: This file contains API service functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to MCP, nodes, environment variables, and serverless agent registration. It includes fetch wrappers, retry logic, event stream subscriptions, and various API calls with detailed request/response handling.

methods.name: setGlobalApiKey
methods.description: Sets the global API key used for authenticated requests.

methods.name: getGlobalApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the current global API key.

methods.name: getNodesSummary
methods.description: Fetches a summary of agent nodes.

methods.name: getNodeDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific node.

methods.name: streamNodeEvents
methods.description: Creates an EventSource for node events.

methods.name: getMCPHealth
methods.description: Retrieves MCP health status for a node.

methods.name: restartMCPServer
methods.description: Restarts a specific MCP server with retry logic.

methods.name: stopMCPServer
methods.description: Stops a specific MCP server with retry logic.

methods.name: startMCPServer
methods.description: Starts a specific MCP server with retry logic.

methods.name: getMCPTools
methods.description: Fetches MCP tools for a server.

methods.name: getOverallMCPStatus
methods.description: Retrieves overall MCP status.

methods.name: getNodeDetailsWithMCP
methods.description: Fetches node details including MCP info.

methods.name: testMCPTool
methods.description: Tests an MCP tool with parameters.

methods.name: getMCPServerMetrics
methods.description: Fetches performance metrics for MCP servers.

methods.name: subscribeMCPHealthEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to MCP health events via SSE.

methods.name: getMCPHealthEvents
methods.description: Retrieves MCP health event history.

methods.name: getMCPHealthModeAware
methods.description: Performs mode-aware MCP health check.

methods.name: bulkMCPServerAction
methods.description: Performs bulk start/stop/restart on MCP servers.

methods.name: getMCPServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves MCP server configuration.

methods.name: updateMCPServerConfig
methods.description: Updates MCP server configuration.

methods.name: getAgentEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Fetches environment variables for an agent.

methods.name: updateAgentEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Updates environment variables for an agent.

methods.name: getAgentConfigurationSchema
methods.description: Fetches configuration schema for an agent.

methods.name: getNodeDetailsWithPackageInfo
methods.description: Fetches node details including package info.

methods.name: getNodeStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status of a node.

methods.name: refreshNodeStatus
methods.description: Manually refreshes node status.

methods.name: bulkNodeStatus
methods.description: Fetches statuses for multiple nodes.

methods.name: updateNodeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a node.

methods.name: startAgentWithStatus
methods.description: Starts an agent with proper state transitions.

methods.name: stopAgentWithStatus
methods.description: Stops an agent with proper state transitions.

methods.name: subscribeToUnifiedStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to unified node status events via SSE.

methods.name: registerServerlessAgent
methods.description: Registers a serverless agent via invocation URL, backend auto-discovers capabilities.
